name: ai-job-search
description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
one_liner: A robot assistant that reads job postings for you, rewrites your resume and cover letter to match each one, and preps you for the interview.
buyer: A career coach or outplacement firm that wants to offer clients an automated, personalized job-application service instead of billing by the hour for manual resume tweaks.
business_use_cases: A career coaching service runs this for clients, generating a freshly tailored resume and cover letter for every job they apply to, cutting hours of manual editing per application.
A university career center lets students self-serve tailored applications instead of booking scarce advisor appointments.
A recruiting or staffing agency uses it internally to quickly repackage one candidate's resume differently for each client role they're pitching.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'done-for-you' job application concierge service built on this, charging per batch of tailored applications produced.
White-label it as a SaaS career coaches can resell to their own clients under a monthly seat license.

steal_this: Fork it, plug in your own resume and profile, and run it against 20 real job postings this weekend — then offer the time saved as a paid service to friends who are job-hunting.
